entities.summary: The murder of Krista Lea Harrison occurred on July 17, 1982, in Marshallville, Ohio, United States. The case remained unsolved for two years, until Robert Anthony Buell was convicted of her murder in 1984. In 2000, Harrison's case appeared on the fifth season of the American television show Forensic Files in an episode titled "Material Evidence."
